newsitem.title: FRANCE: Unions call protests at Elf's Antar unit.
newsitem.headline: Unions call protests at Elf's Antar unit.

text.p: Unions at Elf Aquitaine subsidiary Elf Antar called on Monday for disruption at three of Elf's French refineries this week in a plan to save jobs.
A five-union group in Elf's product distribution subsidiary said it was calling for two days of stoppages at the Donges refinery in western France on November 27 and 28.
It also planned action at the Grandpuits refinery near Paris and Feyzin near Lyon, but it had yet to be defined.
The group -- containing branches of all France's main unions, the CFDT, CGC, CGT, FO and CFTC -- said it was calling for a day of action on November 28.
It said this was to prevent Elf Antar carrying out a plan to cut 330 jobs but did not say whether there would be strikes.
Elf officials were not immediately available for comment.
Deliveries from Donges and Grandpuits have already been disrupted by a separate truckers' strike which has prevented some fuel leaving more than half of France's 13 refineries.
